mapper.sql: m.MATERIAL_ID, m.BID_CASE_ID, m.INSTITUTION_ID, m.BOARD_YEAR, m.STATUS_CD, m.RESULT_CD, m.MEETING_DATE, m.SUBMIT_REQ_ID, m.SUBMIT_SNAP, m.CONFIRMED_SNAP, m.CONFIRMED_BY, m.CONFIRMED_AT, m.FORM_ID, m.FORM_VER, m.CUR_SNAP, m.LAST_SAVED_BY, m.LAST_SAVED_AT, m.CREATED_BY, m.CREATED_AT, m.UPDATED_BY, m.UPDATED_AT
i.NAME_KO AS INSTITUTION_NAME, c.CODE_NAME AS STATUS_NAME, rc.CODE_NAME AS RESULT_NAME

LEFT JOIN INSTITUTIONS i ON i.INSTITUTION_ID = m.INSTITUTION_ID LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE c ON c.CODE_GROUP = 'BOARD_STATUS' AND c.CODE = m.STATUS_CD LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE rc ON rc.CODE_GROUP = 'BOARD_RESULT' AND rc.CODE = m.RESULT_CD
mapper.select: SELECT INSTITUTION_ID FROM BID_CASES WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId}
SELECT BID_CASE_ID FROM BID_ASSIGN_CASE WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD_MATERIAL (BID_CASE_ID, INSTITUTION_ID, BOARD_YEAR, STATUS_CD, FORM_ID, FORM_VER, CUR_SNAP, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{bidCaseId}, #{institutionId}, #{boardYear}, #{statusCd}, #{formId}, #{formVer}, 0, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT a.BID_CASE_ID, a.EMP_NO, u.NAME FROM BID_ASSIGNMENT a LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.EMP_NO = a.EMP_NO WHERE a.ACTIVE_YN = 1 AND a.BID_CASE_ID IN #{cid} ORDER BY a.BID_CASE_ID, a.ASSIGNED_AT, a.EMP_NO
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD_MATERIAL SET STATUS_CD = 'DRAFT', UPDATED_BY = #{by}, UPDATED_AT = #{now} WHERE MATERIAL_ID = #{id} AND STATUS_CD = 'PREP'

UPDATE BOARD_MATERIAL SET RESULT_CD = #{to}, MEETING_DATE = COALESCE(#{meetingDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, MEETING_DATE), UPDATED_BY = #{by}, UPDATED_AT = #{now} WHERE MATERIAL_ID = #{id} AND STATUS_CD = 'CONFIRMED' AND COALESCE(RESULT_CD, '-') = COALESCE(#{from,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '-')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD_MATERIAL_SNAP (MATERIAL_ID, SNAP_NO, VALUES_JSON, NOTE, SAVED_BY, SAVED_AT) VALUES (#{materialId}, #{snapNo}, #{valuesJson,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{note,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{savedBy}, #{savedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT s.MATERIAL_ID, s.SNAP_NO, s.NOTE, s.SAVED_BY, u.NAME AS SAVED_BY_NAME, s.SAVED_AT FROM BOARD_MATERIAL_SNAP s LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.EMP_NO = s.SAVED_BY WHERE s.MATERIAL_ID = #{id} ORDER BY s.SNAP_NO DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD_MATERIAL_LOG (MATERIAL_ID, EVENT_CD, FROM_STATUS, TO_STATUS, FROM_RESULT, TO_RESULT, MEETING_DATE, FROM_EMP_NO, TO_EMP_NO, REQ_ID, REASON, ACTOR_EMP_NO, EMP_VERIFIED, LOGGED_AT) VALUES (#{id}, #{eventCd}, #{fromStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{toStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fromResult,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{toResult,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{meetingDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fromEmpNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{toEmpNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reqId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{actor}, #{verified}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT l.EVENT_CD, l.FROM_STATUS, fs.CODE_NAME AS FROM_STATUS_NAME, l.TO_STATUS, ts.CODE_NAME AS TO_STATUS_NAME, fr.CODE_NAME AS FROM_RESULT_NAME, tr.CODE_NAME AS TO_RESULT_NAME, l.MEETING_DATE, l.FROM_EMP_NO, fu.NAME AS FROM_NAME, l.TO_EMP_NO, tu.NAME AS TO_NAME, l.REQ_ID, l.REASON, l.ACTOR_EMP_NO, au.NAME AS ACTOR_NAME, l.EMP_VERIFIED, l.LOGGED_AT FROM BOARD_MATERIAL_LOG l LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE fs ON fs.CODE_GROUP = 'BOARD_STATUS' AND fs.CODE = l.FROM_STATUS LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE ts ON ts.CODE_GROUP = 'BOARD_STATUS' AND ts.CODE = l.TO_STATUS LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE fr ON fr.CODE_GROUP = 'BOARD_RESULT' AND fr.CODE = l.FROM_RESULT LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE tr ON tr.CODE_GROUP = 'BOARD_RESULT' AND tr.CODE = l.TO_RESULT LEFT JOIN USERS fu ON fu.EMP_NO = l.FROM_EMP_NO LEFT JOIN USERS tu ON tu.EMP_NO = l.TO_EMP_NO LEFT JOIN USERS au ON au.EMP_NO = l.ACTOR_EMP_NO WHERE l.MATERIAL_ID = #{id} ORDER BY l.LOG_ID
SELECT MATERIAL_ID FROM BOARD_MATERIAL WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} AND (CREATED_BY = #{empNo} OR LAST_SAVED_BY = #{empNo}) ORDER BY MATERIAL_ID FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_MATERIAL_LOG l JOIN APPROVAL_STEP s ON s.REQ_ID = l.REQ_ID WHERE l.MATERIAL_ID = #{id} AND l.EVENT_CD = 'SUBMIT' AND s.APPROVER_EMP_NO = #{empNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM APPROVAL_STEP WHERE REQ_ID = #{reqId} AND APPROVER_EMP_NO = #{empNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD_MATERIAL_ACT (MATERIAL_ID, BID_CASE_ID, ACTION_CD, OUTCOME, STATUS_CD, RESULT_CD, SNAP_NO, ACTOR_EMP_NO, EMP_VERIFIED, SCREEN_ID, BUTTON_ID, UI_VALID, LOGGED_AT) VALUES (#{materialId}, #{bidCaseId}, #{actionCd}, #{outcome}, #{statusCd}, #{resultCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{snapNo,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{actorEmpNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{empVerified}, #{screenId}, #{buttonId}, #{uiValid}, #{loggedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT a.ACT_ID, a.MATERIAL_ID, a.BID_CASE_ID, a.ACTION_CD, a.OUTCOME, a.STATUS_CD, a.RESULT_CD, a.SNAP_NO, a.ACTOR_EMP_NO, u.NAME AS ACTOR_NAME, a.EMP_VERIFIED, a.SCREEN_ID, a.BUTTON_ID, a.UI_VALID, a.LOGGED_AT FROM BOARD_MATERIAL_ACT a LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.EMP_NO = a.ACTOR_EMP_NO WHERE a.MATERIAL_ID = #{id} ORDER BY a.ACT_ID DESC
